title: Korean support (i18n)
request:
I'd like to write a new intent for i18n (Korean support). Is this correct to call it a new intent? Or should I call it a new issue?

Create new intent
problem: Every gate view is in English only. The human deciding at the gates is a native Korean speaker who works in English, so each decision is made through a second language, and a label or status line that is misread can lead to approving the wrong thing. The tool has no way to present its views in another language.
acceptance: A gate view rendered in Korean shows every fixed label, badge, button, and status line in Korean.
A gate view rendered without choosing a language is unchanged from today.
Authored text (the request, problem, criteria, questions, and answers) appears exactly as written in every language.
An approval sent from a Korean view names the same gate and rev, and is accepted the same way, as one sent from an English view.

nonGoals.reason: Every interpretation is checked against the human's own words; a translated request or answer would no longer be those words.

openQuestions.text: Is this Korean only, or a general mechanism where Korean is the first added language?
openQuestions.proposal: A general mechanism with English and Korean. Another language is then just another set of translations, and it costs little more than Korean alone.

openQuestions.text: How is the language chosen for a view?
openQuestions.proposal: Per repo, as a setting recorded like the area list, with English as the default. In the solo phase one human reads every view; a per-viewer choice belongs to the team phase, where viewers have identities.

openQuestions.text: When the human writes a request in Korean, what language do agents write the rest of the intent and plan in?
openQuestions.proposal: The request's language. The fields are interpretations checked against the request, which is easiest when both are in the same language.

decisions.question: What does Korean support cover: only the rendered gate views, or also the CLI's messages and errors?
decisions.answer: Gate views only (Recommended): labels, badges, buttons, and status lines in rendered views. CLI messages and errors stay English.
